thread.title: Dow Jones, Apple Stock Lead Stock Market Rally | Investor's Business Daily

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Jones, Apple Stock Lead Stock Market Rally | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes looked to cap off 2018 with a rally in today's stock market . The Dow Jones industrials rose about 200 points amid optimism around the U.S.-China trade talks. Over the weekend, President Trump tweeted that "big progress" was being made after a "very good call" with President Xi of China. Apple ( AAPL ) gained 1%. Apple stock is a major component of the Dow Jones industrials, among other major stock indexes.
X After a promising start to 2018 — the Nasdaq had gained as much as 17.8% by Aug. 31 — the tech-heavy Nasdaq composite is set to decline about 4.2% as of Monday morning. Meanwhile, the Dow Jones industrials and S&P 500 indexes carry losses of 6% and 6.6%, respectively. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Dow Jones Leads Stock Market Rally The Dow Jones industrials led the way with a 1% gain, while the S&P 500 index moved up 0.7% in morning trade. The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite advanced 0.6%, looking to extend a recent win streak to four trading sessions.
After last week's dramatic rise, investors should be on the lookout for a follow-through day , which could happen as soon as today. The follow-through day gives investors the green light to begin buying stocks that are breaking out past proper buy points. But don't be too aggressive , not all follow-through days are successful.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Dow Jones Stocks: Apple Stock Leads Among the Dow Jones stocks , Apple ( AAPL ) was one of the top-performing stocks early Monday with a 1% advance. Despite that, the iPhonemaker is still over 30% off its 52-week high.
Meanwhile, Boeing ( BA ) moved up 2% as it approaches its 50-day line, a potential resistance level. Shares are about 18% off their high as a new base potentially takes shape.
IBD 50 Stocks To Watch: Atlassian Stages Breakout Among the leading growth stocks , software stock Atlassian ( TEAM ) staged a breakout in morning trade. The top stock moved up over 2% to rise above a cup with handle's 89.92 buy point. Be on the lookout for a sharp increase in daily volume to indicate institutions are rapidly moving into the stock. The relative strength line is at a new high. Despite the bullish price action, investors should be wary given the stock market's current market status.
Meanwhile, Leaderboard watch list member Broadcom ( AVGO ) is in the process of forming a first-stage base formation. Shares gained 1% in early trade, extending a win streak to four trading sessions.
